UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1743 
Tremfya (guselkumab) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-500226  
Guideline Name 
Tremfya (guselkumab)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
2/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Tremfya SC 100 mg*  
Diagnosis 
Plaque Psoriasis (PsO)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or verification of paid claims 
documenting ALL of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of chronic moderate to severe plaque psoriasis (PsO)  


--- PDF page 1744 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1744 
 
AND 
 
 1.2 BOTH of the following:  
• 
Patient is 6 years of age or older  
• 
Patient weighs at least 40 kg  
 
AND 
 
 1.3 Greater than or equal to 3% body surface area involvement, palmoplantar, facial, or 
genital involvement, or severe scalp psoriasis  
 
AND 
 
 1.4 History of failure to ONE of the following topical therapies, unless contraindicated or 
clinically significant adverse effects are experienced:  
• 
corticosteroids (e.g., betamethasone, clobetasol, desonide)  
• 
vitamin D analogs (e.g., calcitriol, calcipotriene)  
• 
tazarotene  
• 
calcineurin inhibitors (e.g., tacrolimus, pimecrolimus)  
 
AND 
 
 1.5 History of failure to a 3 month trial of methotrexate at the maximally indicated dose within 
the last 6 months, unless contraindicated or clinically significant adverse effects are 
experienced  
 
AND 
 
 1.6 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ONE of the following topical 
therapies:  
• 
Vtama  
• 
Zoryve 0.3% cream  


--- PDF page 1745 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1745 
 
AND 
 
 1.7 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ALL of the following:  
• 
A preferred^ adalimumab biosimilar or Enbrel (etanercept)  
• 
infliximab  
• 
Otezla (apremilast)  
• 
A preferred^ ustekinumab biosimilar  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a dermatologist  
Notes  
*If patient meets criteria above, please approve at GPI-14.  
 
^PDL link: https://www.uhcprovider.com/en/health-plans-by-state/arizo
na-health-plans/az-comm-plan-home/az-cp-pharmacy.html?rfid=UHC
CP 
 
Product Name:Tremfya SC 100 mg*  
Diagnosis 
Plaque Psoriasis (PsO)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Documentation of positive clinical response to therapy  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a dermatologist  
Notes  
*If patient meets criteria above, please approve at GPI-14. 
 
Product Name:Tremfya SC 100 mg*

Diagnosis 
Psoriatic Arthritis (PsA)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or verification of paid claims 
documenting ALL of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of active psoriatic arthritis (PsA)  
 
AND 
 
 1.2 BOTH of the following:  
• 
Patient is 6 years of age or older  
• 
Patient weighs at least 40 kg  
 
AND 
 
 1.3 History of failure to a 3 month trial of methotrexate at the maximally indicated dose within 
the last 6 months, unless contraindicated or clinically significant adverse effects are 
experienced  
 
AND 
 
 1.4 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ALL of the following:  
• 
A preferred^ adalimumab biosimilar or Enbrel (etanercept)  
• 
infliximab  
• 
Orencia (abatacept)  
• 
Otezla (apremilast)  
• 
Xeljanz (tofacitinib) oral tablet (IR or XR)  
• 
A preferred^ ustekinumab biosimilar  
 
AND

• 
Rheumatologist

Dermatologist

Product Name:Tremfya SC  
Diagnosis 
Crohn's Disease (CD)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  


--- PDF page 1748 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1748 
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming a diagnosis of moderately to 
severely active Crohn's disease (CD)  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a gastroenterologist  
 
AND 
 
3 - ONE of the following:  
 
 3.1 Will be used as a maintenance dose following the intravenous induction doses  
 
OR 
 
 3.2 ALL of the following:  
 
  3.2.1 Will be used for induction dosing  
 
AND 
 
  3.2.2 ONE of the following:  
• 
Frequent diarrhea and abdominal pain  
• 
At least 10% weight loss  
• 
Complications such as obstruction, fever, abdominal mass  
• 
Abnormal lab values (e.g., C-reactive protein [CRP])  
• 
CD Activity Index (CDAI) greater than 220  
 
AND 
 
  3.2.3 Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or verification of paid claims 
documenting BOTH of the following:  


--- PDF page 1749 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1749 
 
   3.2.3.1 Trial and failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ONE of the following 
conventional therapies: 
• 
corticosteroids (e.g., prednisone, methylprednisolone, budesonide)  
• 
6-mercaptopurine (Purinethol)  
• 
azathioprine (Imuran)  
• 
methotrexate (Rheumatrex, Trexall)  
 
AND 
 
   3.2.3.2 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ALL of the following: 
• 
A preferred^ adalimumab biosimilar  
• 
infliximab  
• 
A preferred^ ustekinumab biosimilar  
Notes  
^PDL link: https://www.uhcprovider.com/en/health-plans-by-state/arizo
na-health-plans/az-comm-plan-home/az-cp-pharmacy.html?rfid=UHC
CP 
 
Product Name:Tremfya SC  
Diagnosis 
Ulcerative Colitis (UC)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming a diagnosis of moderately to 
severely active ulcerative colitis (UC)  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a gastroenterologist  


--- PDF page 1750 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1750 
 
AND 
 
3 - ONE of the following:  
 
 3.1 Will be used as a maintenance dose following the intravenous induction doses  
 
OR 
 
 3.2 ALL of the following:  
 
  3.2.1 Will be used for induction dosing  
 
AND 
 
  3.2.2 ONE of the following:  
• 
Greater than 6 stools per day  
• 
Frequent blood in the stools  
• 
Frequent urgency  
• 
Presence of ulcers  
• 
Abnormal lab values (e.g., hemoglobin, erythrocyte sedimentation rate, C-reactive 
protein)  
• 
Dependent on, or refractory to, corticosteroids  
 
AND 
 
  3.2.3 Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or verification of paid claims 
documenting BOTH of the following:  
 
   3.2.3.1 Trial and failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ONE of the following 
conventional therapies: 
• 
6-mercaptopurine  
• 
aminosalicylate (e.g., mesalamine, olsalazine, sulfasalazine)  
• 
azathioprine  
• 
corticosteroids (e.g., prednisone)  
 
AND 


--- PDF page 1751 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1751 
 
   3.2.3.2 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ALL of the following: 
• 
A preferred^ adalimumab biosimilar  
• 
infliximab  
• 
Xeljanz (tofacitinib) oral tablet (IR or XR)  
• 
A preferred^ ustekinumab biosimilar  
Notes  
^PDL link: https://www.uhcprovider.com/en/health-plans-by-state/arizo
na-health-plans/az-comm-plan-home/az-cp-pharmacy.html?rfid=UHC
CP 
 
Product Name:Tremfya SC  
Diagnosis 
Crohn's Disease (CD), Ulcerative Colitis (UC)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient demonstrates positive clinical response to therapy as evidenced by at least ONE of 
the following:  
• 
Improvement in intestinal inflammation (e.g., mucosal healing, improvement of lab 
values [platelet counts, erythrocyte sedimentation rate, C-reactive protein level]) from 
baseline  
• 
Reversal of high fecal output state  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a gastroenterologist  
 
2 .  Revision History  
 
Date  
Notes
